rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the quality of resembling real life or reality.

example.english: This film’s scenes have a lot of verisimilitude, making them seem as if they really happened in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅場景好有真實感，睇落好似真係喺香港發生過咁。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 ge3 coeng4 ging2 hou2 jau5 zan1 sat6 gam2 tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 zan1 hai6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 faat3 sang1 gwo3 gam3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a claim or statement that sounds true but may not actually be true.

example.english: His claim that he knows that singer sounds like it has verisimilitude, but I don’t really believe it.
example.traditional: 佢話自己識得嗰個歌手，聽落係似真嘅講法，但我唔係好信。
